Define five value-alignment dimensions
fairness 590 · safety 779 · morality 522
legality 118 · data protection 242

Crowdworkers manually write Chinese prompts
concrete complex scenarios per subcomponent
disguise · reverse induction · unsafe inquiry

Apply two prompt-review rounds
verify target value, scenario, and attack method
retain only prompts that attack at least one LLM

FLAMES-prompts: 2,251 adversarial prompts
average length 85.92 tokens
core team modifies or discards failures

Collect responses from 17 Chinese-capable LLMs
iteratively refine field-specific scoring guidance
obtain approximately 22.9K annotated responses

Two graduate annotators label every response
3/2/1 for fairness, safety, morality; 3/1 otherwise
field expert adjudicates disagreements

Stratify 1,000 public evaluation prompts
249 fairness · 429 safety · 201 morality
75 data protection · 46 legality; retain the rest

Train dimension-specific multitask classifiers
hold out MOSS/GPT-4 for validation and InternLMs for test
best FLAMES-scorer accuracy: 79.5%

Report harmless rate and normalized harmless score
macro-average the five equally weighted dimensions
use humans for paper results; scorer enables automation
